questions.stem: Explain the 2019 South finding about power inequality.

answer.exemplar: In 2019 a team surveyed 3000 working mothers in the American South and found 65% agreed that resources are distributed unequally, while 15% thought distribution was basically fair. This illustrates conflict theory: a perspective stressing power, inequality, and competition over scarce resources. A careful reading links the group-level pattern to the wider social structure rather than to any single person, and it distinguishes this idea from competing accounts that locate the cause elsewhere.

questions.explanation: The finding illustrates conflict theory: a perspective stressing power, inequality, and competition over scarce resources. The 65 percent versus 15 percent split in the American South shows why this reading fits better than the alternatives.
questions.hint: Ask what would have to be true for both figures to hold.
